title: Thai Zesty Chicken Curry
description: A flavorful and spicy Thai-inspired dish made with chicken, zesty sauce, and northern Thai spices.

ingredients.name: Thai zesty sauce
ingredients.notes: Can be adjusted for desired level of spiciness

ingredients.name: Northern Thai curry paste
ingredients.notes: Can be adjusted for desired level of spiciness

ingredients.name: Fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Can be adjusted for desired level of saltiness

ingredients.name: Brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Can be adjusted for desired level of sweetness

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Thai zesty sauce and northern Thai curry paste. Cook, stirring constantly, for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in the coconut milk and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to medium-low and let simmer for 10-15 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the fish sauce and brown sugar.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and sliced peanuts.
Serve hot over rice or noodles.
